protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol is the inference API protocol served by the Service.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Operation is the normalized inference operation of the request

requestedModel.description: RequestedModel is the model name requested by the downstream. Note that it is read from the request itself and it is therefore also set for the requests that are eventually rejected by Octelium.

model.description: Model is the model name reported by the upstream provider itself. It can differ from the RequestedModel whenever the request used an alias or an unpinned model name.

stream.description: Stream is set for the requests that asked for a streamed response

usage.description: Usage is the token usage of the request/response

estimatedInputTokens.description: EstimatedInputTokens is Octelium's own pre-flight input token estimate. It is always set for the parsed inference requests regardless of the Usage field.

responseID.description: ResponseID is the response identifier reported by the upstream provider itself

finishReason.description: FinishReason is the completion status reported by the upstream provider itself (e.g. "stop", "length", "tool_calls")

timeToFirstToken.description: TimeToFirstToken is the duration between accepting the request and the first generated content of a streamed response

eventCount.description: EventCount is the number of the `text/event-stream` events of the response

octelium.api.main.core.v1.AccessLog.Entr.title: LLM
octelium.api.main.core.v1.AccessLog.Entr.description: LLM is the LLM-gateway-specific information

source.title: Source
source.description: Source shows where the token counts came from

inputTokens.description: InputTokens is the number of the input/prompt tokens

outputTokens.description: OutputTokens is the number of the generated/completion tokens

totalTokens.description: TotalTokens is the total token count reported by the upstream provider itself. Whenever the provider reports none, which is the case for the ANTHROPIC protocol as well as for many OpenAI-compatible servers, it is computed as the sum of the input and output tokens plus only those cache token counts that the provider accounts for additively (i.e. the ANTHROPIC ones). The OPENAI cached and reasoning token counts are already included in the input and the output counts respectively and they are therefore never added again.

cacheReadInputTokens.description: CacheReadInputTokens is the number of the input tokens that were read from the provider's prompt cache. Note that the providers account for it differently: it is a subset of the InputTokens field for the OPENAI protocol while it is additive to it for the ANTHROPIC one.

cacheCreationInputTokens.description: CacheCreationInputTokens is the number of the input tokens that were written to the provider's prompt cache. It is only reported by the ANTHROPIC protocol and it is additive to the InputTokens field.

reasoningTokens.description: ReasoningTokens is the number of the reasoning tokens. It is only reported by the OPENAI protocol where it is already included in the OutputTokens field.

octelium.api.main.core.v1.AccessLog.Entr.description: Usage is the token usage of the request as reported by the upstream provider

http.description: HTTP shows the underlying HTTP information of the request/response

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the MCP-specific type of the entry

protocolVersion.description: ProtocolVersion is the MCP protocol version declared by the request (e.g. "2026-07-28"). Note that it is read from the request itself and it is therefore also set for the requests that are eventually rejected by Octelium.

method.description: Method is the JSON-RPC method of the request (e.g. `tools/call`)

name.description: Name is the logical MCP target of the method whenever it has one (i.e. the tool name, the prompt name or the resource URI)

requestID.description: RequestID is the JSON-RPC request `id` normalized into a string

isNotification.description: IsNotification is set for JSON-RPC notification requests

resultType.description: ResultType is the `resultType` discriminator of a successful result (e.g. "complete", "input_required"). It is a string rather than an enum since MCP extensions can define further values.

isProtocolError.description: IsProtocolError is set when the response carried a JSON-RPC `error`

errorCode.description: ErrorCode is the JSON-RPC error code of the response (e.g. -32601 for `Method not found` or -32020 for `HeaderMismatch`)

errorMessage.description: ErrorMessage is the JSON-RPC error message of the response

isToolError.description: IsToolError is set when the method is `tools/call` and the successful result carried an `isError` value. This is a different layer from the ErrorCode field: the call succeeded at the protocol layer while the tool itself failed.

eventCount.description: EventCount is the number of the `text/event-stream` events of the response

notificationCount.description: NotificationCount is the number of the JSON-RPC notifications, such as progress notifications, of the response stream

ttlMs.description: TTLMs is the `ttlMs` cache freshness hint of the result, if set

cacheScope.description: CacheScope is the `cacheScope` of the result, if set (e.g. "public")

client.description: Client is the client information reported by the downstream itself. It is NOT an identity.

sessionID.description: SessionID is the value of the `Mcp-Session-Id` header used by the protocol revisions between 2025-03-26 and 2025-11-25. It is an MCP transport identifier that is unrelated to the Octelium Session as well as to the AccessLog entry's own sessionID field.
